about_the_game:
"Experience the timeless strategy game, designed for players of all skill levels. Whether you’re new to the game or a seasoned expert, enjoy the ultimate backgammon experience.

🌍 Play Online

Engage in live games with real opponents.

Create private tables with friends or join public matches with players worldwide.

🔄 Two Game Modes

Match Points: Classic gameplay to achieve the most wins.

Doubling Cube: A high-stakes challenge for advanced players.

🎯 Climb the Leaderboards

Track global rankings and win streaks.

View detailed stats and match history.

Participate in tournaments for exciting rewards.

✨ Modern and Intuitive Design

Clean, easy-to-navigate boards.

Smooth animations and responsive controls.

Clear dice rolls and move highlights.

Optional undo feature for a relaxed pace.

🧩 Customize Your Game

Choose between Standard and Doubling Cube rules.

Adjust match lengths in Match Points mode.

Set up private tables for games with friends.

✅ Key Features

Private table options for tailored experiences.

Sleek visuals and optimized performance.

Quick matchmaking and smooth online play.

Suitable for all experience levels.

Join players worldwide in exploring the perfect blend of luck and strategy. Roll the dice, plan your moves, and test your skills in this classic board game.

📥 Download Backgammon Premium today and start your journey!"

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+ (Intel) Big Sur 11.0 (Apple)
  • Processor: Intel and Apple silicon
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable Intel and Apple GPUs
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio support

name: Backgammon Premium

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and later versions
  • Processor: 2 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Shader Model 4.0
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio support
